desc: a rotmaw plague-hulk in profile: a HULKING, BROAD, hunched undead giant with heavy thick arms hanging low, a wide barrel chest, a bald grey corpse head with sunken eyes, three large pale mushroom caps growing from its shoulders and skull, ragged brown loincloth, thick tree-root legs, and a small bundle of dried flowers clutched in one fist. Its build is MASSIVE and stooped -- broad shoulders far wider than the hips
defect: the current side strip draws a SLENDER, upright, thin-limbed figure instead of this bulky hunched hulk

desc: a storm elemental in profile: a BROAD, heavy-shouldered humanoid of dark storm-cloud stone with a smooth featureless helm-like head glowing pale blue at the eye slit, thick shoulders and arms wreathed in crackling pale-blue lightning arcs, and a coiling smoke tail instead of legs. Its upper body is BULKY and wide -- as wide as reference 1 shows it
defect: the current side strip draws a slim body that loses the heavy shoulder mass
